name: AA Efficiency Dashboard
postCreateCommand: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && sudo bash -lc 'for f in /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*; do if [ -f "$f" ] && grep -qs "dl.yarnpkg.com" "$f"; then mv "$f" "$f.aa-disabled"; fi; done; apt-get update; DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y chromium' && python -m playwright install chromium
